## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
      (squash-merged as the commit message — see
      [ADR-0008](../docs/adr/0008-squash-merge-only.md)).
- [ ] The `Plan` check's output was reviewed, not just skimmed for
      pass/fail.
- [ ] If this changes a documented trade-off (auth, state/backend, CI/CD,
      branch protection, merge conventions, module structure), a new or
      amended ADR is included — see
      [`docs/adr/README.md`](../docs/adr/README.md).
- [ ] If this changes what a reader needs to know to *run* the repo (not
      just *why* a decision was made), `README.md` is updated too.
